attribution.localizedCause: The inherited fixture extractor suppresses exporter stdout/stderr through subprocess capture and deletes its temporary coefficient container on exception, making a post-capture exporter failure opaque.

decision.rationale: Authorize one prospectively frozen receipt-preserving retry that keeps the forward implementation and hypothesis unchanged while exposing the exporter failure boundary.

hypothesis.rationale: Neither the open GGML forward nor any tensor or arithmetic-branch comparison ran, so the frozen transfer hypothesis was not tested.

retiredDimensions: Opaque exporter failures that discard the captured container and report only CalledProcessError are not acceptable oracle evidence.
transferableLessons: Treat fixture export as an explicit receipt boundary: retain command stderr, container size/hash, and failure context. A separate control export of the bound Q3 post-update container succeeds for all 246 tensors, so do not retire the forward hypothesis.
uncertainties: The failed temporary parameters.coefs was deleted, so its exact digest and the exporter stderr are unavailable; no claim can distinguish malformed capture, tensor access, or host resource failure.

reasons: The closed capture reached the selected evaluation, but the fixture exporter returned nonzero before fixture materialization or either open-forward execution; no parity measurement exists.
